Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed challenging the Gazette Notification dated 17.02.2024 under Section 28 of the U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad Adhiniyam, 1965 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Adhiniyam').

entities.text: U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad Adhiniyam, 1965
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The petitioners have also challenged the notices dated 28.02.2024 and 11.03.2024 issued by the Parishad under Section 29 of the Adhiniyam.
2. Contention is that the Gazette Notification under Section 28 of the Adhiniyam is illegal in as much as it is not in consonance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Kamlesh Kumar And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 4 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58046074/
1 Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
3.

entities.text: Kamlesh Kumar And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the Parishad submits that the Parishad is still in the process of collating the objections received from different persons including the petitioner herein.
It will constitute a committee to examine the objections and thereafter, make recommendation to the State Government as provided under Section 31 of the Adhiniyam.

4. Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsel for the Parishad, we are of the opinion that the challenge advanced is premature as the objections filed by the petitioners are still to be considered.
5. The petition is accordingly, disposed of as premature.
